⚖️ Framework Comparison

Compare FlowX with other modern HTML-first/lightweight Javascript libraries.

Library Bundle Size Dependencies Key Features
FlowX ~2.5 KB gzipped None
  • HTML-first AJAX engine with fx- attributes
  • Native viewport intersection (revealed) trigger
  • Built-in DevTools overlay timeline log console
  • Lightweight ES/UMD/IIFE formats for CJS and CDNs
HTMX ~14 KB gzipped None
  • AJAX request swapping from markup
  • Out-of-band updates support
  • WebSockets and SSE extensions library
  • CSS Transition hooks
Alpine.js ~9 KB gzipped None
  • Inline client state management
  • Two-way model data binding
  • Directives for styling transitions
  • Declarative UI reactive hooks
Unpoly ~45 KB gzipped None
  • Server-driven multi-frame layers
  • Modal overlays routing and layers control
  • Form validations auto-interception
  • Navigation history sync
